limitations: The governed context.meetings vocabulary artifact owns portable Meeting terminology; compatibility pointers and provider labels are non-canonical projections.
This model owns portable Meetings, participants, commitments, summaries, recording attribution, and transcript relationships; CRM, Projects, and Tasks remain separate selectable Context packs.
Organization, person, Project, and Task links are optional typed resource identities and do not make those Context packs required dependencies.
Provider participant identifiers must be normalized into Meeting participant resource identities and never become CRM contacts by implication.
Commitment extraction is review evidence only until a separate Automation explicitly dispositions it into a Task, Project update, or retained Meeting commitment.
Meeting summary or commitment writes require separate Automation, Integration, configuration, approval, checkpoint, and verification authority.
